title: Working Family Allowance (WFA) Scheme
kind: administrative scheme rules and rates (official publication, not statute)
publisher: Working Family and Student Financial Assistance Agency (WFSFAA), HKSAR Government
text_not_deposited_reason: WFSFAA Important Notices: except as expressly permitted or with WFSFAA's prior written authorisation, any reproduction, adaptation, distribution, dissemination or making available to the public is prohibited; download is permitted only for personal or non-commercial internal use. Only the overview page was requested, once, to verify the scheme; no rules or rates pages were fetched and no text was kept.
verified_how: Overview page (title 'Working Family and Student Financial Assistance Agency') says the WFA Scheme is applied for on a household basis (including singleton households), with working-hour requirements and income and asset limits; Basic, Medium or Higher Allowance, plus Child Allowance, at full, 3/4 or half rate according to household income.
legal_basis: Administrative scheme funded by Legislative Council appropriation; there is no Working Family Allowance Ordinance.
